cause_quote: The commit added `legacyCredentials: legacyCredentials?.credentials` to the auth value used for document comparison, while socket retirement reset that value with `self.auth = .nativeDevice(gatewayUrl: gatewayUrl, token: token, password: password)`, clearing the field and making the same Gateway compare unequal on reconnect.
user_saw: Input queued while the macOS dashboard was offline could disappear when the app reconnected to the same Gateway.
summary: The fix keeps the macOS dashboard document across same-Gateway socket reconnects and refreshes its startup credentials for future loads.
reasoning: I checked the causing commit and its parent: the existing saved-profile reconnect path retained the document when the route and configured credentials matched, since there was no socket-owned credential field in the auth value. The commit added that field and cleared it on socket retirement while leaving the full-auth comparison in place, so retirement before reconnect made the next authenticated configuration replace the WebView and discard its queued input. The fix PR reports that the retirement-first case failed on the unchanged base and passed with the fix.
